items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: So we'd have Wardell Gray and Clark Terry, and several other guys that we liked

ctx.x: Weekends, yeah. I would play there because... Most of the time, if I didn't have nothin' to do, I'd just play up there. He told me, like, to make it my home, because he was tickled to death to have me come up. And all the guys used to come out there; you know, all the guys, that would be playing at the Hi-Hat in Boston, they would come to Christie's after they'd get off of work, and we'd jam all night and all that. So we'd have Wardell Gray and Clark Terry, and several other guys that we liked, or that played…
Whoever was in the Boston area.
